confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cairo tourist pricing, not checked against live listings or current menus. The Egyptian pound has been volatile with high inflation, so prices may have moved substantially by July 2026. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary widely by district, season, and classification. Cocktail (about 3.5x beer) and wine glass (about 3x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX observation came from RBA-attributed search snippets (the exchange rates overview and statistics pages), not from opening table F11.1 directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used as an anchor. Levels are set below other North African and Levant capitals such as Tunis and Amman for food and budget lodging, reflecting post-devaluation Egyptian price levels, with 3-star hotel pricing closer to regional tourist-hotel norms.
